retries._note: Extra attempts allowed after the first one.

independent_review._note: Risk at or above which an independent (Codex) review is required before the run can finish. Routes where it is offered when available.

commands._note: Project test/lint/typecheck commands. Only the project config (agentship.config.json) may set them; otherwise package.json scripts are used. Each command needs a one-time developer approval per project.
